title: Santiago/Quotes
summary:
"I took an oath to keep Sophie safe from danger in any form."
- Santiago to Dante Vale (The Casterwill Client )

"There's only one way to know what you're made of. Fight me, one on one."
- Santiago to Dante Vale (The Casterwill Client )

"I'm trusting you to see her safely returned home."
- Santiago to Dante Vale (The Casterwill Client )

"As your loyal bodyguard, I'll do anything I can to help."
- Santiago to Sophie Casterwill (All Work and No Pay)
